title: Reject
description: The engine's answer to a Hello it will not accept. The reason is a stable code so a client can act on it; the detail is a safe sentence and never says which part of a credential was wrong (108 section 14).

reason.description: Why the connection was refused. `unauthenticated` never distinguishes a missing credential from a wrong one.

detail.description: A safe explanation for a person. Carries no credential material, no panic text, and no machine paths.

protocolMajor.description: The major version this engine speaks, so a mismatched client can report what it needs.
